defects.what: Two clasped hands are knotted together: an orange-skinned finger ends in the other woman's pink nail and neither hand can be counted to a thumb and four fingers.
defects.where: centre, the clasped hands on the pier planks

defects.what: A raised hand in the foreground is a pointed mitten with the fingers fused into one block plus a thumb, and it belongs to a red-haired stranger the script does not have.
defects.where: bottom right corner, raised hand and red-haired head

defects.what: The man's trousers are two colours: the leg behind the dog is dark grey and the front leg is beige.
defects.where: lower half, the man's two trouser legs

defects.what: Instead of the dog tugging the coat hem with his teeth, the man pinches the hem with a metal clip and strap that runs down to the dog's head like a leash; the hands are also pale with no red handkerchief.
defects.where: left middle, hand on coat hem and strap above the dog

defects.what: The man standing behind Usman wears a red t-shirt, black shorts and bare legs instead of Indio's long dark grey coat, so it is not Indio.
defects.where: whole upper frame, the man's clothes and legs

defects.what: Lucifer has long messy grey-brown hair and an older face, so he reads as a different man from the short neat black-haired Lucifer of the other shots.
defects.where: head, upper half

defects.what: The Bakunawa under Indio's hand is a small brown knobbly snake head with fangs and a bulging eye instead of the giant moon-pale serpent of the other shots.
defects.where: bottom right, the serpent head under Indio's hand

defects.what: Lucifer has long hair to his shoulders and is see-through, with Indio's head and the sea showing through his legs and coat.
defects.where: top half, the kneeling figure

defects.what: Usman has both ears folded down instead of one folded ear.
defects.where: both ears, top of the dog's head

defects.what: The man reflected in the serpent's eye is a young man in a t-shirt and shorts, not the forties Indio in a long coat.
defects.where: centre, figure inside the pupil

defects.what: Indio's arm is bare in a rolled grey short sleeve with a black wristband and no red handkerchief, not his long dark grey coat.
defects.where: centre, the arm by the lamp

defects.what: The blade has no grip: the right hand pinches the gold star crossguard directly with the fingertips. The sword has no handle at all in an extreme close-up where it is the subject.
defects.where: top centre, hand at the star guard

defects.what: The blade is a long katana with a black wrapped hilt instead of the short silver blade with a gold star guard used in k07/k46.
defects.where: bottom left, the glowing blade

defects.what: The raised sword is a long katana with a plain silver crossguard and black wrapped hilt, not the short star-guard blade.
defects.where: centre, the sword Indio holds up

defects.what: The star guard has blade points sticking out on both sides and an ornate black handle, so it does not read as a working dagger.
defects.where: whole frame, guard and handle

defects.what: The gold star sits partway up the blade above a separate round guard, so the sword has two guards.
defects.where: centre, star and round guard

defects.what: The hand at the chin is a thick mushy block whose fingers are hard to tell apart.
defects.where: centre, hand under the chin

defects.what: The four clasped hands between Lola and Inay are tangled and their fingers cannot be counted.
defects.where: centre, the joined hands

defects.what: Faint scratched letter-like marks ('C M A R') are on the serpent's forehead.
defects.where: upper middle, the serpent's brow

defects.what: Every page on the table is filled with letter-like lines, and the front right signer has a yellow smear on his cheek.
defects.where: table pages and right signer's face

defects.what: The open Bible pages are covered in letter-like pseudo-text rather than faint lines.
defects.where: both open pages

defects.what: Gold letter-like scribbles are on the book cover.
defects.where: left, the leather cover

defects.what: The sea chart carries letter- and number-like marks.
defects.where: chart surface around the ship models

defects.what: The forest giant's two hands at his belt are a knotted lump with the thing he holds; no fingers can be counted.
defects.where: centre right, the giant's hands at his waist

defects.what: On the front ship's deck a white-clad figure has a balloon-shaped body without a readable waist or legs, and the orange figure beside her is a back with arms but no clear head.
defects.where: lower middle, the people on the front deck

defects.what: The blade is a curved kitchen-knife shape with a plain gold ring guard and no star, unlike the star-guard blade of k07/k45/k57.
defects.where: bottom left, the glowing blade in his hand

refuted.what: Lucifer's hair is shaggy and grey-brown with a stray loop on top, not the short neat black hair of k00/k01/k29.
refuted.why: At full size the hair is dark charcoal, a little shaggy, with the same face, white coat and dark shirt; he reads as the same Lucifer.

refuted.what: Lucifer is drawn with shaggy, longer hair and a different, harder face than in the opening shots.
refuted.why: Dark tousled hair, same pale face, white coat; a harder expression is acting, not a different man.

refuted.what: Lucifer's hair is a wavy layered mop with blue highlights, softer and longer than the short neat cut elsewhere; still recognisable.
refuted.why: Reader 1 itself calls him still recognisable; wavy dark hair and the same face and white coat do not meet 'would not be recognised'.
